categories.name: Admission to Normal Care (NC)
categories.description: Patient is admitted to a normal care inpatient ward (Admission NC), advancing the patient toward disposition while balancing ward capacity and care needs. Judged against post-discharge indicators and timeliness.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared OR alternative id=15 (Admission NC). It represents standard inpatient admission without intensive care routing.

categories.name: Admission to Intensive Care (IC)
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care inpatient ward (Admission IC). This option impacts the Minimize time-to-treatment softgoal via a SomeNegative (-25) contribution due to resource intensity, and is measured against treatment windows and outcomes.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared OR alternative id=16 (Admission IC). Represents high-acuity ward placement for severe sepsis presentations.
